summary: The assessor-named Drosophila dataset (dryad.g5g43) resolves and is openly readable through its Zenodo mirror: roughly 143 Drosophila species pairs with Nei's genetic distance and pre- and post-zygotic isolation indices. It covers one genus, so the claim about families, plants and other animals is untested by it. No multi-clade table of crossing outcomes against independent distance exists in the repositories searched; Open Tree and TimeTree can supply distance for a compiled table.
next_step: Compile cross-clade crossing records (e.g. birds, Lepidoptera, frogs, fishes, Nicotiana/Solanum plants) from the literature, then add Open Tree or TimeTree distances; use the Drosophila CSV as the first slice.
obstacles_confirmed: Dryad file downloads need a bearer token; the Zenodo mirror served the same CSV openly.
The only crossing-vs-distance table found is restricted to Drosophila.
No dataset of crosses between species of different families was found.
